name: Friday Harbor
say: The islands' town, behind Brown Island. Mind the ferry coming in.

ashore.name: the pub above the ferry landing
ashore.say: Fish and chips on the deck, watching the ferry load.

name: Roche Harbor
say: The old lime works at the north end of San Juan Island, with a long guest dock.

ashore.name: the old hotel on the quay
ashore.say: A table in the garden, and the colours come down at sunset.

name: Deer Harbor
say: A quiet bay on the west side of Orcas, inside Pole Pass.

ashore.name: the dock store at Deer Harbor
ashore.say: Ice cream on the float, with your feet over the edge.

name: Rosario
say: Cascade Bay in East Sound, under Mount Constitution.

ashore.name: the mansion on Cascade Bay
ashore.say: A drink on the lawn while the organ plays inside.

name: Fisherman Bay
say: Lopez Island's landlocked bay. The way in is shallow: go in on a rising tide.

ashore.name: the bakery in Lopez Village
ashore.say: A walk up the spit for pastries, and everyone waves.

name: Reid Harbor
say: A long inlet on Stuart Island, with park buoys and the trail to the lighthouse.

ashore.name: the trail to Turn Point
ashore.say: An hour's walk to the lighthouse to watch the ships round the point.

name: Echo Bay
say: The big bay on Sucia Island. Sandstone shores, park buoys, no road and no shop.

ashore.name: the beach at Sucia
ashore.say: A driftwood fire on the shingle and fossils in the cliff.

name: Jones Island
say: A small island park off Orcas. Deer come down to the beach.

ashore.name: the landing on Jones Island
ashore.say: Ten minutes across the island to the south beach for the sunset.

name: Blind Bay
say: Shaw Island's bay on Harney Channel, across from the Orcas landing.

ashore.name: the little store at the Shaw landing
ashore.say: A cold drink on the bench while the ferry comes and goes.

name: Spencer Spit
say: A sand spit on Lopez reaching for Frost Island. Anchor either side of it.

ashore.name: the beach at Spencer Spit
ashore.say: Clams for the pot and a log cabin at the end of the spit.
